name: Convinex
author: Convinex Media

sections.description:
Convinex is a powerful AI-powered chatbot solution that helps businesses provide 24/7 customer support on their WordPress websites. With easy setup and automatic configuration, you can have a professional chatbot running in minutes.

Key Features

  • Easy Setup: Register on main site, enter Business ID in WordPress
  • AI-Powered: Intelligent responses using advanced AI technology
  • Automatic Configuration: Business information automatically fetched and configured
  • Customizable: Choose widget position, colors, and behavior
  • Mobile Responsive: Works perfectly on all devices
  • No Coding Required: Simple point-and-click configuration
  • Auto-Cleanup: Widget automatically removes itself when plugin is deactivated
  • Smart Caching: Advanced cache-busting ensures widget updates are always reflected

How It Works

  1. Register or Enter Business ID:

    • New users click “Register & Get Business ID” to go to registration page
    • Existing users can enter their Business ID directly
    • Each user gets a unique Business ID for their business

  2. Automatic Configuration:

    • Plugin automatically fetches your business information
    • Chatbot settings are configured automatically
    • No manual setup required

  3. Chatbot Goes Live:

    • Widget appears on your website automatically
    • AI-powered responses based on your business information
    • 24/7 customer support without human intervention

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Convinex → Settings
  3. If you don’t have a Business ID:
    • Click “Register & Get Business ID”
    • This redirects you to the registration page
    • Register and get your Business ID
    • Return to WordPress and enter your Business ID
  4. If you have a Business ID:
    • Click “I Have Business ID”
    • Enter your Business ID
    • Click “Verify & Save Business ID”
  5. Save settings
  6. Your chatbot is now live!

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A Business ID from convinex (get it free through registration)

Support

For support, documentation, and updates, visit:
* Website: https://convinex.com
* Documentation: https://convinex.com/docs
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Convinex”
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Click Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  4. Click Upload Plugin
  5. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  6. Click Activate

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Convinex → Settings
  2. Click “Register & Get Business ID” to register on the main site
  3. Copy your Business ID from the registration page
  4. Return to WordPress plugin settings
  5. Click “I Have Business ID” and enter your Business ID
  6. Click “Verify & Save Business ID”
  7. Save settings
  8. Visit your website to see the chatbot in action!
sections.faq:
Do I need to register to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a Business ID to use the chatbot. Click “Register & Get Business ID” in the plugin settings, which will redirect you to the registration page on the main convinex website.

Is the chatbot free?

The plugin itself is free. Chatbot service availability depends on your convinex subscription plan. Check our website for pricing details.

Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

Yes! You can customize the widget position (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left) and choose a custom color for the chatbot button.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, the chatbot is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices including smartphones and tablets.

Can I use multiple Business IDs?

Each WordPress installation should use one Business ID. If you need multiple chatbots, you’ll need separate WordPress installations or contact support for enterprise solutions.

How do I get my Business ID?

You can get your Business ID by:
1. Clicking “Register & Get Business ID” in plugin settings (redirects to registration page)
2. Registering on the convinex website
3. Finding it in your convinex dashboard after logging in

Where do I register?

Click the “Register & Get Business ID” button in the plugin settings. This will redirect you to the registration page on the main convinex website where you can create your account and get your Business ID.

  • Enhanced widget auto-removal when plugin is deactivated
  • Updated UI improvements (send button styling)
  • Better compatibility with WordPress caching plugins
  • Widget status checking for automatic cleanup
  • Microtime-based cache-busting for always-fresh widget loading

  • Initial release
  • Registration redirect to main site
  • Business ID verification
  • Automatic business information fetching
  • Widget integration
  • Customizable appearance
  • Mobile responsive design
